page.layout: One page of text, one column, running head at top with page number; faint show-through of the facing page's notes in the right margin (not transcribed). No notes in the page's own margins.

main_text.p: tentiam istam quantocyus exsequantur. Tantà judicis severitate deterriti, prori- piunt se è Schola quam plu- rimi pusiones Genii, quos nominare mihi in promptu non est; Antefignanum tamen novi: Gerro est: qui pridem ex trivialibus Scholis, ex Grammatica & imâ Diale- ctícâ huc appellens, gerras multas nobis contexuit, ver- borum tricis detinuit, sylla- bis anxiè discutiendis exer- cuit, proposuit quæstiuncu- las multas exiles, frivolas, rancidas, auctaria, corollaria, parerga: Efto: Fugâ sibi con- sulant: Acuratâ in abjectam illam plebeculam accusatio- ne.

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page's marginal notes on the right edge is illegible and was left out. The first line is in the running head and is not part of the text. Word "ne." at line end is a catchword-like fragment of "accusatione," kept as printed.
